title: Lantern read output
description: Machine-readable summary of a Beacon evidence bundle, as produced by `lantern read -f json`.

source.description: Resolved absolute path of the bundle file that was rendered.

receipt_count.description: Total number of receipts in the bundle (after validation).

receipt_ids.description: Stable list of receipt IDs in load order. Useful for cross-referencing Beacon's signature manifest.

event_types.description: Counts of each `event_type` value observed (gate.evaluated, gate.failed, bundle.signed, inference.observed, etc.).

evidence_types.description: Counts of `evidence_type` values observed in receipts that carry them (control_framework, board_minutes, etc.).

signed_count.description: Number of receipts that carry a non-empty `signature` envelope. Lantern reports presence only; cryptographic verification is Beacon's responsibility.
